price.value: USD 33,695.95 list / 22,995 sale (no laptop); 37,845.95 list / 27,145 sale with laptop

deployment_evidence.value: successor to Stanford Mobile ALOHA; ALOHA-class kits widely used across academic labs, Google DeepMind and the Physical Intelligence/LeRobot ecosystem; unit counts undisclosed

notes: Data-collection/research rig, not a service robot: includes 2 leader arms for human puppeteering in addition to 2 follower arms. Discovery-file price band 'Stationary AI ~$8-17k' does not match current pricing (Stationary lists $23,995.95, $15,995 on sale); Mobile AI $23-34k band confirmed.
